overview.description: The MarketDesk International Momentum ETF (XUSM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. XUCM is an actively managed ETF but uses a rules-based, quantitative momentum strategy designed to balance capital appreciation with downside risk. XUCM systematically identifies international companies based on quality and price momentum, constructing an equal-weighted portfolio of 50100 high-conviction names. XUSM was launched on Sep 15, 2026 and is issued by MarketDesk.
